TRAI Launches Digital Connectivity Rating Platform to Standardize Infrastructure Transparency

02 Nov 2026, 02:17 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: trai.gov.in

2 min read

Key takeaways

Overview of the New Platform

The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has officially launched the Digital Connectivity Rating (DCR) Platform, a centralized portal designed to provide consumers with transparent data regarding the digital infrastructure of properties. This initiative stems from the Rating of Properties for Digital Connectivity Regulations and is supported by a dedicated mobile application for field assessments.

Key Functionalities

The platform serves as a multi-stakeholder interface connecting Property Managers, Digital Connectivity Rating Agencies (DCRAs), and consumers. Its core features include:

  • For Property Managers: A centralized space to register properties—including public, government, commercial, and private categories—apply for connectivity ratings, and track the assessment progress.
  • For Rating Agencies: A standardized workflow to conduct site measurements, log test results, and generate digitally signed certificates.
  • For Consumers: A public search portal to verify the connectivity status of buildings before finalizing lease or purchase decisions.

Assessing Digital Readiness

The DCR framework evaluates properties based on several technical benchmarks to ensure reliable service. These parameters include:

  • Fibre Readiness: Assessment of existing fiber-optic infrastructure.
  • Mobile Network Availability: Coverage strength and signal reliability within the premises.
  • In-Building Solutions: Infrastructure support for indoor connectivity.
  • Wi-Fi Readiness: Capability and reach of local wireless networks.

Consumer Empowerment and Verification

According to the announcement, the platform aims to make digital connectivity a measurable attribute of real estate. Consumers can verify the authenticity of a property’s rating certificate using the provided QR code, which confirms the document's validity. This system is intended to encourage property developers to integrate essential digital infrastructure during the planning stages of construction.

How to Access

Stakeholders and the public can access the new portal directly at https://dcrp.trai.gov.in The platform integrates secure payment processing for rating fees and utilizes eSign technology to maintain the integrity of certification documentation. For specific inquiries, TRAI has directed interested parties to contact their IT division via email at advisorit@trai.gov.in.
